dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan-Schedule 6a-Natural Heritage System mapping depicts Brampton Plan Schedule 6a Natural Heritage System, which is composed of protected environmental area such as valleyland, floodplain, wetlands, woodlands, etc.
The Natural Heritage System is an interconnected network of natural features, ecological functions, and supporting lands that contribute to environmental health and biodiversity across the city. It is intended to be protected, maintained, restored, and enhanced to support resilient ecosystems and sustainable community development.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
